newsitem.title: USA: US House Ways and Means Chair to vote for Gingrich.
newsitem.headline: US House Ways and Means Chair to vote for Gingrich.

text.p: House Ways and Means Committee Chairman Bill Archer, R-Texas, said Monday he will vote to re-elect Newt Gingrich as Speaker.
"I've taken a look at the (ethics) subcommittee report, I'm satisfied that he should be re-elected Speaker," Archer said at a media briefing.
His comments came just hours after House Banking Committee Chairman James Leach, R-Iowa, said Gingrich should step down as speaker.
The House is scheduled to vote on whether to re-elect Gingrich, R-Ga., to the Speaker post Tuesday.
